description.value: A family-oriented lakeside resort on Fraser Lake, directly off Highway 16 between Prince George and Prince Rupert, with forested and open lake-view tent sites, a shower house, boat launch, and direct waterfront access. Open May 1–October 15; tent sites from $32/night.

address.value: 14108 Highway 16 East, Fort Fraser, BC V0J 1N0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched and is detailed. The resort sits on Highway 16 between Prince George and Prince Rupert, making it a logical overnight stop on the Yellowhead cycling corridor.
